user.title: Set up Super Skipper
user.description:
Super Skipper watches your media players. When a keyword you choose shows up in the title or artist, it skips the track, switches to another station for a while, or mutes the player.

After this step, open **Super Skipper** in the sidebar to create your first rule.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Super Skipper is already set up. Open it in the sidebar to manage the rules.

data_description.snooze_minutes: How long the **Snooze** button pauses every rule.
data_description.cooldown_seconds: The least time between two actions on the same player. Prevents double skips when a player reports a track twice.
data_description.confirm_seconds: How long a track must play before a rule acts. Filters out metadata that flickers while a player changes tracks.

basics.title: What to look for
basics.description: Choose the keywords, the players to watch, and what to do when a keyword plays.

data_description.name: Shown in the rule list and in the logbook, for example `No ABBA on the radio`.
data_description.keywords: Words or phrases to look for, like an artist, a song title, or `Advertisement`. Press Enter after each one.
data_description.players: The rule acts on each of these players separately.
data_description.action: **Automatic** looks at what plays: a track is skipped; a radio stream goes to the station you choose in the next steps, or is muted until the keyword is gone when no station is set. **Skip** always goes to the next track. **Switch station** always plays something else and returns later. **Mute** silences the player until the keyword is gone.

matching.name: Matching
matching.description: How the keywords are compared with what plays.

data_description.match_mode: **Whole words** matches `ABBA` in `ABBA - Waterloo` but not in `Kabbalah`. **Any part of a word** matches both. **Regular expression** treats each keyword as a pattern. Case and accents never matter.
data_description.match_fields: The media player attributes to search. Radio stations often put the station name in the channel or artist attribute.
data_description.ignore_texts: Texts a station shows between songs, like its name or slogan. When the title contains one of these, Super Skipper treats it as station information, not as a new track.

data_description.max_consecutive: After this many tracks skipped in a row, the rule waits until something plays that does not match. Prevents endless skipping when a whole album matches. `0` means no limit.

switch.title: Switch station
switch.description:
Choose what to play instead. Pick a station from the media browser (the **Radio Browser** source lists thousands of stations) or run your own actions, for example a script that starts a station. With the automatic action this is optional: without a station, a radio stream is muted until the keyword is gone.

{players}

data.repeat_mode: When the keyword still plays after returning

data_description.station: Pick a player to browse with; the rule plays the same station on each of its players.
data_description.station_actions: Actions run with the variables `player` (the entity ID) and `rule` (this rule's name).
data_description.return_after_minutes: Minutes to wait before playing what was on before. `0` keeps the new station on.
data_description.return_fallback_media: Super Skipper remembers what played and tries to return to it. That does not work on every player (for example Spotify or MusicCast), so choose what to play if it fails.
data_description.return_fallback_actions: Alternative to the fallback media above: your own actions, with the same variables.
data_description.repeat_mode: **Switch again, with a limit** switches again up to the limit below, then stays on the other station. **Switch again, without limit** keeps switching. **Switch only once** leaves it on after the first return.
data_description.repeat_limit: Times to switch again before staying on the other station.

mute.title: Mute
mute.description: The player is muted while the keyword plays, and unmuted when something else has played for a moment.

data_description.hold_seconds: Seconds something else must play before the sound comes back. Covers stations that show their name between songs.
data_description.max_mute_minutes: Safety limit in minutes. The sound always comes back after this time. `0` means no limit.

conditions.title: When the rule may act
conditions.description: Leave everything empty to let the rule act at any time.

data_description.persons: Persons whose presence decides whether the rule acts.
data_description.presence_mode: How the persons above must be at home. Ignored when no persons are chosen.

advanced.name: Advanced
advanced.description: Extra conditions, like a time of day or a state. All of them must be met.

data_description.conditions: The same conditions you know from automations.

error.players_required: Choose at least one media player.
error.invalid_regex: One of the keywords is not a valid regular expression. Fix it or choose another match mode.
error.players_cannot_skip: These players do not support skipping tracks, so the rule cannot act on them: {players}.
error.players_cannot_play_media: These players cannot play media chosen in the media browser, so use actions instead: {players}.
error.station_required: Choose a station or add actions that start one.
error.fallback_required: Choose what to play if returning fails, or set **Return after** to 0.
error.name_required: Enter a name for the rule.
error.invalid_conditions: The conditions are not valid. Check them and try again.
error.invalid_actions: These actions are not valid. Check them and try again.

options.any_home: At least one of them is home
